name: POST /api/voice-agent/tools/:tool_id/signing-secret - The secret the voice runtime signs this tool's requests with
description: Tenant route (Bearer tenant JWT). Returns the request-signing secret of one of the tenant's app-registered tools so its endpoint can verify that a request really came from the ProjexCloud voice runtime (supports 1bdbfb86-09c3-410e-bcee-be79df98074d#AC1: the agent invokes an app-registered HTTPS tool with a valid HMAC signature). The secret is derived on the platform from VOICE_TOOL_SIGNING_KEY and the tool's signing_secret_ref (PATCH the tool with a new ref to rotate it). Response: tool_id, name, signing_secret_ref, signing_secret and scheme { algorithm hmac-sha256, signature_header X-Projexcloud-Signature, signature_format t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC>, signed_payload <t>.<Idempotency-Key>.<raw request body>, idempotency_key <call_id>:<turn_index>:<tool name>, tolerance_seconds 300 } — verify with @projexlight/voice-client verifyToolRequest. Every retrieval is audited as voice.tool.secret_revealed.v1 (who and which tool, never the value); the response is Cache-Control: no-store. POST because it returns a secret. Errors: unknown tool or another tenant's 404; missing/invalid token 401; no signing key configured in production 503 (ToolSigningNotConfigured).
